notes.title: Ver.1.0.9b Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Märchen Forest. 
This is Shinano Ishiguro, the game's developer.

This patch is a response to bug reports sent by everyone on a daily basis.
There are no major changes, but it's a patch with lots of small improvements.

Bug Fixes
-Fixed the collision of the part that gets stuck in the terrain over the mushrooms in the EX dungeon.
-Fixed a bug where dungeon levels were not displayed correctly under certain conditions
-Fixed a bug that quest tasks were not displayed correctly
-Implemented a screening script for achievements at the 4th layer entrance
Other minor bug fixes

I hope you continue to enjoy playing Märchen Forest.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.9a Patch information
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Märchen Forest.
This is Shinano Ishiguro, the developer.
The following modifications have been made so that 4K monitor users can play comfortably.

-Added a "4k" to the resolution setting of the title screen.
-Added a "4k" to the resolution setting of the in-game option.

* Since this was an urgent inquiry, i have prioritized the release of this patch.

In parallel with fixing bugs, i will continue to make repairs centered on the requests of players.

i look forward to your continued support of Märchen Forest.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578166/c454df31ce644665d1d6374d98d8702a878ab81e.jpg

Thank you for playing Märchen Forest. This is Shinano Ishiguro, the game's developer.
This patch addresses issues that were reported by users during the long holiday in Japan at the start of May.
Bug Fixes
-Bug causing area movement and encounters to overlap fixed.
-Bug causing game speed to double under certain conditions during combat fixed.
-Bug enabling players to continue fighting at 0 HP under certain conditions fixed.
-Bug preventing encounters from occurring under certain conditions fixed.
-Bug preventing some buff names from displaying properly fixed.
-Bug preventing some treasure chests on the third level from replenishing when escaping the dungeon fixed.
-Bug disabling Skip function when using Relic - Tomb Sculpture fixed.
-Bug causing voiceover to overlap when using Relic - Grimoire fixed.
-Typo in quest task description fixed (Base Camp No. 7 -> Base Camp No. 9).
-Bug preventing camera in the 7th room of the fifth level from working properly under certain conditions fixed.
-Other minor bugs fixed.
-Mismatched voiceover/text fixed.
-Bug causing shadows to render incorrectly fixed.
-Bug causing incorrect objects to appear in the field of the second level fixed.
In addition to squashing bugs, the development team will continue making adjustments to the game according to player requests.
We hope you continue to enjoy playing Märchen Forest.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578166/cfcf9ef29e154354392f3fa8e6d5c0f9e76a552f.jpg

Thank you for playing Märchen Forest. This is Shinano Ishiguro, the game's developer.
Starting with this patch, we will be adding the much-requested equipment stats display.
We are also focusing on bug fixes for issues that have been reported by users.

[Issues Improved]
-Stats display for each item when selecting equipment added.

[Bug Fixes]
-Experience gained from defeating first level boss, Lv5 Abyss Shade, increased.
-Max number of dishes obtainable from from Mole Cafe fixed.
-Bug preventing field music from playing when the menu was closed under certain conditions fixed.
-Bug where "Reduction" would appear while defending against Flamel the Alchemist's Dragon's Breath when damage was not being reduced fixed.
-Meteor Talisman's stat display bug fixed.
-Second level boss's area name display bug fixed.
-Lv 2 Holy Chalice stat display bug fixed.
-Bug where incorrect required food value was shown when using Destruction fixed.
-Bug in task display for the Full-Scale Exploration Begins quest fixed.
-Bug where using Seaweed Extract during combat did not heal debuffs fixed.
-Bug where voiceover did not match subtitles when examining mushrooms in the 4th level entrance fixed.
-Bug causing BGM volume in Options to be set to 10 under certain conditions fixed.
-Bug causing Rosetta's graphics to disappear when skipping certain scenes fixed.
-Bug causing quests to complete despite having been terminated prematurely fixed.
-HP recovery notification text size after consuming Sushi while in Spirit of the East state fixed.
-Bug where making Astral-style Kebabs and then consuming them in a camp did not accomplish the task fixed.
-Bug that opened the menu while returning to the title screen fixed.
-Other minor bugs fixed.

[Other Fixes]
-Credits updated
In addition to squashing bugs, the development team will continue making adjustments to the game according to player requests.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Märchen Forest.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578166/581cca0da23f86c5a09013fb22b0e694de56007a.jpg

Thank you for playing Märchen Forest.
In this patch, we focused on ensuring smoother gameplay.
Loading screens between scenes have been optimized, and battle tempo has also been increased slightly.

[Issues Improved]
-Recovery items can now be used in bulk during battle.
-Certain in-battle scenes can now be skipped.
-Loading time when starting and finishing Petey's training shortened.
-Game no longer loads when fishing.
-Item effects now display in inventory.
-Brightness of screen flash that occurs when entering commands during battle adjusted.

[Bugs Fixed]
-Bug causing encounters to overlap when returning to the entrance from the grave marker fixed.
-Bug causing notification text to overlap at the entrance to the 4th floor fixed.
-Other minor bugs fixed. 

In addition to squashing bugs, the development team will continue making adjustments to the game according to player requests.
We hope you continue to enjoy playing Märchen Forest.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578166/a2f7a0dbf02b374d977defedca0bc9418cbc9a60.jpg
Thank you for playing Märchen Forest.
This is Shinano Ishiguro, the game's developer. Our team is currently working on fixing critical bugs, as well as bugs reported by players.


In this patch, we focused primarily on fixing bugs that may interfere with game progress. In the future, we plan to gradually adjust game balance, fix visual glitches, and tweak the system as needed to ensure smooth gameplay.


[Bugs Fixed]
-Bug preventing the menu from opening when using potions in certain areas fixed.
-Bug causing encounters to temporarily stop occurring after using a recipe fixed.
-Bug causing the volume setting to randomly reset fixed.
-Character movement glitch when winning a battle fixed.
-Other minor bugs fixed.

[Details of Minor Bug Fixes]
-Bug causing Baas's normal attack to be in slow motion fixed.
-Texture of second level ladder fixed.
-Bug causing bars to remain onscreen after second layer trick activated fixed.
-Bug causing animations to not play correctly after defeating an enemy at the start of a battle fixed.
-Bug preventing Rosetta from tracking properly fixed.
-Bug causing playback errors of Mylne's voice when quiz redraws overlapped fixed.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Märchen Forest.

notes.title: Update information
notes.notes:
Implemented screen setting option in the "Options" menu during the game.
This allows you to switch screen size and switch between "window mode" and "full screen" mode during play.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578166/cd83e64a02156f09467ca34d53791f1f00414132.jpg

Thank you for playing Märchen Forest. This is Shinano Ishiguro, the game's creator.

The development team is currently working on top-priority fatal bugs.
In this patch, the Achievements bug, as well as the bug that caused enemies to spawn when changing areas (thus making it impossible to progress), have been fixed.

Bugs Fixed
-Bug that caused the game to spawn enemies when changing areas fixed. Areas where enemies will NOT spawn have been added in places where bug was occurring previously.
-Bug preventing certain Achievements from being unlocked fixed. Some Achievements that failed to unlock in the past will now unlock at the 4th floor entrance; however, if the following Achievements were completed prior to the Ver. 1.0.1 patch update, they will need to be repeated: Ruins, Laboratory Archives
-Bug where it became impossible to progress once health reached 0 in certain areas fixed.
-Other minor bugs fixed.

Other Updates
-Attack pattern added to Lv3 Ancient Shade
-Two new attack patterns added to Zombie Knight

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Märchen Forest.

notes.notes:

Thank you for playing Märchen Forest. This is Shinano Ishiguro, the game's creator.
In this update, Achievements have been added by popular demand, especially for the Steam version.
Please note that many Achievements are unlocked via events, so if you have already completed the game, you will need to play from the beginning in order to unlock these Achievements.

Patch Contents
-Steam Achievements added
-Other minor bugs fixed

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Märchen Forest.
